headword: {駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}
reading: ちゅうしゃじょうだい

definitions.gloss: parking fee; parking lot charge; cost of parking
definitions.explanation: The fee charged for using a parking lot or parking space. In Japan, parking is rarely free, especially in urban areas, making this a common everyday expense.

examples.japanese: {駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}はいくらですか。
examples.english: How much is the parking fee?

examples.japanese: {都心|としん}は{駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Parking fees are expensive in the city center.

examples.japanese: {月極|つきぎめ}の{駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}だけで{毎月|まいつき}{三万円|さんまんえん}もかかる。
examples.english: The monthly parking fee alone costs 30,000 yen per month.

notes:
Composed of {駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう} (parking lot) and {代|だい} (charge, fee — the same suffix as in {電気代|でんきだい}, {食事代|しょくじだい}). A practical term that comes up frequently in daily life and travel in Japan.

In urban Japan, especially Tokyo, monthly parking ({月極|つきぎめ}{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}) can cost as much as apartment rent in some areas. This is one reason why car ownership rates are lower in major cities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}がかかる: parking costs money
- {駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}を{払|はら}う: to pay for parking
- {月極|つきぎめ}の{駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}: monthly parking fee
- {駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}{込|こ}み: parking fee included

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {駐車料金|ちゅうしゃりょうきん}: parking charge — more formal, often on signs
- {駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}: parking lot — the place itself
- {路上駐車|ろじょうちゅうしゃ}: street parking — parking on the road
